description: Figure 4.1 presents a line plot titled “Whisper fine-tuning, type = base,” illustrating the Word Error Rate (WER) over six training epochs for different quantization and adaptation configurations of the base Whisper model. The x-axis, labeled “epoch,” spans from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks. The y-axis, labeled “WER,” ranges from 20 to 60, with major gridlines at intervals of 10. Five distinct lines are plotted: “base AdaLoRA_int4” (solid blue line with square markers) begins at approximately WER 58 and decreases to about 39; “base AdaLoRA_int8” (solid blue line with circle markers) starts near 56 and ends around 37; “base int4” (dashed blue line with square markers) begins at ~53 and drops to ~34; “base int8” (dashed blue line with circle markers) starts at ~50 and declines to ~33; and “base full” (dotted blue line with triangle markers) remains relatively flat, starting at ~22 and ending at ~19. All lines show a general downward trend in WER across epochs, with the “base full” configuration consistently achieving the lowest error rate throughout training.
